title: Factorial
description: Tech mod adding many interesting and powerful machines!
body:
Welcome to **Factorial**

![Mod logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94334227a9aae91e24cd8815f8be6b5581fc467e_0.webp)

This mod is made as a simple and fun tech mod, adding 10+ new materials and 20+ machines useful for automating resources and materials, as well as many building blocks and foods!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/TqTzrDhQNu8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Features:

**Machines** allow for more advanced crafting or automation of resources (here are a few examples):

- Crusher - allows you to turn raw materials into dusts to make the material output two times bigger
- Press- turns ingots into plates for crafting
- Crystal growing machine- grows crystals to automate materials such as amethyst, echo shards, redstone or quartz
- Alloy smelter - makes alloys from two materials

**Multiblocks** are machines made from multiple blocks that serve more advanced purpouses:

- Centrifuge - extracts dusts from crushed blocks such as granite, diorite or andesite
- Alloy Forge - allows for advanced alloys sucha as Voidsteel or for faster alloying of regular alloys

The mod also adds many building blocks such as cut versions of blocks or the new Cognite block set, as well as foods such as Chocolate or gameplay mechanics like the Shield of Resonance or Sculk Silencer.





This mod was made entirely by me, **Mrzblj** as a passion project.
